'''Broga Masrii''', more commonly known as '''Broga the Hutt''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who led the [[Three Families]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Quesh war]], Broga and his fellow clan leaders [[Portho Kaltemmic]] and [[Jeelta Urdosh]] were forced to side with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the Sith Empire and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. However, Portho and Jeelta, alongside Broga's bodyguard, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Berin Fraal]], [[Death/Legends|died]] to Imperial forces under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Dracen]], but Broga was spared and worked with them to save himself.<ref name="TOR:Impside" /> However, he quickly returned to the Republic,<ref name="Venom Safeguards">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Venom Safeguards|Quesh}}</ref> to which Dracen responded by launching a siege on the Hutt's palace that ended in its capture.<ref name="Broga's Palace">{{TORcite|type=codex|Broga's Palace}}</ref>

Broga was eventually captured by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Magras]] and forced to work for the Empire once more, but he was eventually rescued by the Republic.<ref name="Reclaiming Quesh">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Reclaiming Quesh|Quesh}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
Broga first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is the subject of both the Imperial and Republic storylines on the planet, acting as opposition to the Sith Empire during "Quesh Showdown" and as an ally to the Republic throughout their storyline. Though there is an option to slay Broga in the Imperial storyline,<ref name="TOR:Impside" /> the Hutt appears alive and well in the Republic storyline, despite the latter taking place after the former, implying that the canonical choice was to spare Broga,<ref name="Venom Safeguards" /> even though dark side choices are presented as the default for Imperial characters, automatically being chosen should content involving them be skipped.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

===Gameplay alternatives===
After striking down Berin Fraal, Imperial players are given the option to either spare Broga for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points or kill him for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] alignment points.<ref name="TOR:Impside" /> No matter the choices made, Broga will still appear in the Republic storyline, indicating the former to be the canonical option.<ref name="Venom Safeguards" />
